loader_kwargs.item_description: Field meters with warranty and service-credit tradeoffs

files.content:
# Legal Warranty Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: warranty_months_ext, service_tier, credit_schedule.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include warranty_months_ext, service_tier, credit_schedule with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

tables.name: approval_rules

tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_log (approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

tables.name: approval_term_requirements

tables.name: delegations
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE delegations (delegate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)

files.content:
# Warranty Tradeoff Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-208
Item: FIELD-METER-24
Quantity: 24
Target unit price: 255.00
Required terms_json keys: warranty_months_ext, service_tier, credit_schedule.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include warranty_months_ext, service_tier, credit_schedule inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
warranty_months_ext: 36
service_tier: advance_replacement
credit_schedule: field_meter_credit_v2

tables.name: buyer_term_requirements

tables.name: purchase_orders

# Orion Warranty Sales Policy
FIELD-METER-24 may not sell below 239.70 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 249.90.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include warranty_months_ext, service_tier, credit_schedule in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
warranty_months_ext: 36
service_tier: advance_replacement
credit_schedule: field_meter_credit_v2
